chunks: And he said in another report:
"And it is the dawn about which there is no doubt.

key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: the dawn, meaning the true break of day

ai.seo_question: What is the dawn about which there is no doubt in the rulings of fasting and the morning prayer?
ai.summary: This report identifies the intended meaning as the true dawn, the unmistakable break of day. In the context of fasting and salat, it indicates the time at which eating and drinking become forbidden for the fasting person and the morning prayer becomes permissible.
